note: Literature establishes MAU2 variants as causing Cornelia de Lange syndrome 7 (CdLS7), characterized by microcephaly, short stature/growth delay, neurodevelopmental delay, and typical CdLS craniofacial dysmorphisms.

evidence.text: Parenti et al. delineated CdLS7 in a cohort of 18 individuals with 15 heterozygous MAU2 variants, reporting presentations ranging from classic CdLS to milder phenotypes, with short stature and microcephaly as major consistent features.

source.title: Pathogenic variants in the cohesin loader subunit MAU2 lead to a new Cornelia de Lange Syndrome subtype
source.quote: Affected individuals display a wide range of phenotypes, from classic CdLS to milder presentations, with short stature and microcephaly as consistent features.

evidence.text: GeneReviews highlights MAU2 among the causative genes for CdLS, characterized across the spectrum by distinctive craniofacial features (synophrys, arched eyebrows, long eyelashes), cognitive delays, microcephaly, and growth failure.

source.title: Cornelia de Lange Syndrome - GeneReviews - NCBI - NIH
source.quote: The diagnosis of CdLS is established in a proband with suggestive clinical features and/or a heterozygous pathogenic variant in BRD4, MAU2, NIPBL, RAD21, or SMC3
